title: Reports of USOM Provincial Representatives for the Month Ending 31 August 1965
citation: Report, USOM [U.S. Operations Mission] – Reports of USOM Provincial Representatives for Month Ending 31 August 1965, unclassified, Reports Officer, MRCC (Provincial Operations), USOM, Saigon. Rufus Phillips Collection (2397), Vietnam Center and Sam Johnson Vietnam Archive, Texas Tech University, item 23970101001.
notes: Eighty-four pages covering every province of South Vietnam for August 1965, including the Tay Ninh (24) report for the month the timeline places the accusation at Nui Ba Den. Read in full; what it does and does not record is set out in research/records-request/vnca/usom-provincial-reports-1965.md.
